mentions.name: scry.io
mentions.description: A platform that makes the public internet SQL-queryable by crawling, cleaning, indexing, and embedding many web sources into source-aware schemas, solving the query contention problem with free-floating pricing. It currently crawls over 1M records/sec while in alpha, and aims to bring a 10PB NVMe cluster online by November as a public benefit project, giving prosocial researchers, builders, and their agents low-friction access to run analytical queries over the public internet.
mentions.problem: Researchers and builders lack low-friction access for running analytical queries over the public internet.
mentions.audience: Prosocial researchers, builders, and their agents who need low-friction access to run analytical queries over the public internet.
